claims.text: Treat most staphylococcal folliculitis with topical mupirocin or topical clindamycin
claims.quote: Treat most staphylococcal folliculitis with topical mupirocin or topical clindamycin.

claims.text: If empiric therapy fails or folliculitis recurs: Gram stain and culture pustules (gram-negative or MRSA) and culture the nares for nasal staphylococcal carriage
claims.quote: If empiric therapy does not result in a cure, or folliculitis recurs, pustules are Gram-stained and cultured to evaluate for gram-negative or methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) etiology, and nares are cultured to evaluate for nasal staphylococcal carriage.

claims.text: Decolonization: topical mupirocin with chlorhexidine gluconate or dilute bleach baths; often effective but often only temporarily
claims.quote: Decolonization strategies using topical mupirocin in combination with chlorhexidine gluconate or dilute bleach baths are frequently effective, but often temporarily successful.
